title: Owner call: answer cues in the season, Tiro and practice
body:
## Summary
Answer cues (ward word before contact) are on in Training, Roster and Lab and off in the season, the local Tiro run and practice.

## Description
packages/game/src/answer-cue.ts gates on the arena-session kind; the card left the season off pending the owner.

## Flow
- owner plays a season bout -> no cue -> decide whether the season should teach or test

## Expected impact
New players learn the ward words in the mode they actually play.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - cues where players need them
Before: off in season/Tiro/practice
After: owner decision
Method: simulation - a product call, no instrument decides it
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: Answer-cue dimming misses sigil-player telegraphs and Fire/Air shapes
body:
## Summary
Only threat art is dimmed; telegraphs drawn without art and Fire/Air effect shapes are not, and a dimmed threat loses its warning mark.

## Description
sigil-player.ts was outside arena-render B's write set (75d8b77).

## Flow
- Training vs Fire -> a non-reaching threat stays bright

## Expected impact
The "only what reaches you" read works for every school.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - consistent dimming
Before: art-only dimming
After: all threat draws dimmed
Method: simulation - needs a sigil-player test
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Finish the lab-ui.ts split: still 1112 lines after combat-lab A
body:

title: Smoke registry still pins d3/forecast to fixed ports the kit no longer uses
body:
## Summary
packages/tools/src/smoke/registry.ts lists 4210/4197 for d3 and forecast; since 3e53518 those suites take an OS-assigned port, so --parallel batches them more cautiously than needed.

## Description
Rewiring breaks plan.test.ts:22, outside smoke A's write set.

## Flow
- mark kit suites as port-free in the registry; update plan.test

## Expected impact
Parallel smoke runs batch correctly.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - batch count
Before: d3+forecast batched by fixed port
After: free
Method: simulation
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Explain the 28 residual VR parity divergences (9 groups)
body:
## Summary

## Description

title: Owner reading: both light builds idle 43% with no legal bolt
body:

The new plan-branch ledger (48c8c18) shows light builds on light:idle (nothing legal) 43% of the time; fire_heavy withholds 55%, air_heavy 60%.

Before: light idle 43%

title: Pre-existing art test failures: test_a14 (missing sources) and test_waves verdict
body:

title: FigureLibrary.load is never called; arena sprites always fall back
body:
## Summary
Scout finding: FigureLibrary.load has no caller and public/arena-sprites.json has empty frames, so that sprite path always draws procedural fallback bodies.

## Description
Too small for a challenge card; needs a zero-caller grep confirmation and an owner call on whether the path is dead.

## Flow
- grep callers; delete or wire

## Expected impact
No dead render path.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - dead code
Before: 1 uncalled loader
After: 0
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
